## Recovery checks

Worker termination and stuck-task recovery passed 3/3 times: 3 completed, 0 dead, 0 left processing.

## Qualification observations

- The 30-minute sustained retry soak accepted 1,801 tasks: 1,800 completed, one exhausted its full five-attempt budget, 353 retried, and none remained pending, failed, dispatching, or processing.
- During the soak, sampled worker CPU stayed between 0.64% and 8.13%; dispatcher heartbeat age stayed at or below 15.34 seconds.
- Three repeated installed-wheel PostgreSQL/Redis/Django/Huey end-to-end smokes passed, including broker outage and recovery.

## Baseline review

All release gates passed. Soft baseline drift appeared in `db-outage`, `priority-lane`, `priority-lane-batch-pressure`, `resilience-long`.
Repeated runs separated short-run acceptance jitter and stochastic retry tails from
correctness regressions, so no baseline was automatically promoted.

## Test environment and scope

- macOS arm64, PostgreSQL 16 through Toxiproxy, and Python 3.13.
- Resilience scenarios exercise the async SQLAlchemy path. Huey/Redis recovery was verified separately through repeated installed-wheel integration tests.
- Timings are local regression signals, not portable performance benchmarks.
- This generated report contains aggregate qualification results; detailed logs and
  request traces are not distributed with the package.
- Results qualify the tested release candidate and environment, not universal production
  capacity.
